description: Radio buttons in React (checked={size === v} with onChange): a click checks one and unchecks the group's other (onChange only for the newly checked one; a checked one gets only the click), arrows move and check within the group (across rows, skipping disabled ones), a radio button whose onChange sets no state is checked by a click, arrow or its label and then restored with its group to the state (React's restoreControlledState), a cancelled click, Tab entering the group at its checked button, a programmatic value
